title: Imp Jar & Lucky 13 Blackcurrant Aniseed Menthol 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Aniseed Menthol from Imp Jar and Lucky 13 combines the sharp sweetness of ripe blackcurrants with the spicy kick of aniseed and a brisk, refreshing blast of menthol. This e-liquid is a heady symphony of contrasting flavours, providing a bold, refreshing vape that awakens the senses. The dark, fruity essence of blackcurrant perfectly complements the liquorice-like notes of aniseed, while the menthol adds an invigorating, cool finish that makes every puff an exhilarating experience. This enticing flavour is part of an exciting series from the collaboration between Imp Jar and Lucky 13, known for their innovative and beloved e-liquid creations. This partnership combines the best of both worlds: Lucky 13's flair for capturing authentic flavours with Imp Jar’s versatile 50/50 formulation, making these e-liquids suitable for a wide array of devices, from pod kits to starter kits. The 50PG/50VG ratio in these shortfill bottles offers compatibility beyond sub-ohm devices, extending to MTL vape kits with different coil resistances. With 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an extra 10ml space for a 10ml nicotine shot, these shortfills give vapers complete control over their experience. Add a single 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot to create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, tailored just to your liking. Imp Jar’s collaboration with Lucky 13 not only brings innovative flavours but also offers a practical and economical alternative to smaller bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid, ensuring your favourite tastes last even longer.
